headlines.description: Mitchell Trubisky threw three touchdown passes and ran for a score in the Chicago Bears' 31-24 victory over Dak Prescott and the slumping Dallas Cowboys on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mitchell Trubisky helps Bears beat Cowboys 31-24

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw the longest touchdown pass of his career and became the 10th quarterback in NFL history to reach 50,000 yards, leading the Atlanta Falcons to another dominating win over Carolina, 40-20 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan leads Falcons to another big win over Panthers, 40-20

headlines.description: Lamar Jackson threw three touchdown passes and the Baltimore Ravens became the AFC's first team to clinch a playoff berth following a 24-17 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens clinch AFC playoff berth with 24-17 win over Bills
Browns stay in playoff hunt, ground out 27-19 win over Cincy

headlines.description: Aaron Jones rushed for a season-high 134 yards and a touchdown on just 16 carries, Aaron Rodgers threw for 195 yards and the Green Bay Packers did enough to beat the Washington Redskins 20-15 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aaron Jones leads Packers past Washington, 20-15

headlines.description: Danielle Hunter had three of Minnesota's five sacks to spearhead a resurgence by the defense, and the Vikings sailed past Detroit 20-7 on Sunday to stick the Lions with their sixth straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Defense delivers as Vikings sail past Lions 20-7

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo decisively delivered a fourth-down pass to George Kittle with time running out, and the veteran tight end vigorously galloped up the sideline, embracing an opportunity to defiantly jerk his head back and forth as a Saints defender...
headlines.shortLinkText: Garoppolo's 4 TD passes help 49ers top Saints, 48-46

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New York Jets

headlines.description: Sam Ficken kicked a 44-yard field goal as time expired to give the New York Jets a 22-21 comeback victory over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ficken's FG as time expires leads Jets past Dolphins 22-21

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw for 456 yards and four touchdowns, helping the Tampa Bay Buccaneers rally to beat the reeling Indianapolis Colts 38-35 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston throws for 456 yards, 4 TDs as Bucs rally over Colts

headlines.description: Rookie Drew Lock threw for 309 yards and three touchdowns, Kareem Jackson had an interception and returned a fumble 70 yards for a touchdown against his former team as the Denver Broncos built a huge first-half lead and coasted 38-24 over the Houston...
headlines.shortLinkText: Lock throws 3 TDs in first half as Broncos beat Texans 38-24

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for 314 yards and three touchdowns, including an 84-yarder to Austin Ekeler that was the longest completion of the quarterback's 16-year NFL career, and the Los Angeles Chargers handled the Jaguars 45-10 Sunday to end a three-game...
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers end skid, hand Jaguars 5th straight lopsided loss

headlines.description: Ryan Tannehill threw for 391 yards and three touchdowns, Derrick Henry ran for two scores and the Tennessee Titans won their fourth straight game by beating the Oakland Raiders 42-21 on Sunday.

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Kansas City clinched the AFC West when Bashaud Breeland knocked away Tom Brady's fourth-down pass attempt to Julian Edelman in the end zone Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: KC survives mistakes, take AFC West with 23-13 win over Pats

headlines.description: Diontae Johnson ran for an 85-yard touchdown on a punt return and caught a pass for another score to lead the Pittsburgh Steelers over the Arizona Cardinals 23-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers hang on for 23-17 victory over Cardinals

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Jared Goff passed for 293 yards and two touchdowns, Todd Gurley ran for 79 yards and a fourth-quarter TD and the Los Angeles Rams prevented the Seattle Seahawks from clinching a playoff berth with a 28-12 victory Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams stay in playoff hunt, end Seahawks' 5-game streak 28-12

events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Eli Manning isn't done yet. Neither are the Philadelphia Eagles.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles rally past Manning, Giants 23-17 in OT
